installer: self-verifying: apply.ps1 compares all 8 payload files against checksums.json before touching the machine
safety: CL-002/003 removes only directories with 0 files; any directory with content is kept and reported
CL-006 reports giant logs by default; deletion needs -PurgeLogs and a dead PID
CL-007 writes user environment variables only when all three values are supplied; the API key never enters the package, the report or the logs
every write is backed up into a single rollback set (-Rollback restores it)

tests.name: checksum self-check
tests.detail: 8/8 payload files SHA-256 match; a tampered copy aborts with "checksum mismatch"

tests.name: dry run writes nothing
tests.detail: fixture tree hash identical before/after, backup store never created

tests.name: CL-001 rotation patch
tests.detail: rotation="00:00" -> rotation="100 MB", retention/compression untouched, original kept in backup

tests.name: CL-002/003 residue
tests.detail: 0-file residue removed, real packages kept, package.json reference stripped and still valid JSON

tests.name: CL-004 empty bundle dir
tests.detail: empty declared dependency detected and reported

tests.name: idempotent re-run
tests.detail: tree hash unchanged, rotation appears exactly once, second run reports skip

tests.name: CL-006 gating
tests.detail: dead-PID log reported then deleted with -PurgeLogs; live-PID log kept in both runs; savedBytes recorded

tests.name: rollback
tests.detail: logger_utils.py and package.json restored byte-for-byte, removed empty residue dir recreated

tests.name: real machine
tests.detail: CL-001 already 100 MB -> skip, dsh-shared 32 files -> kept, no *.tmp, no giant log, all four LLM_* vars present; nothing written, backup dir intentionally not created

tests.name: shipped zip end-to-end
tests.detail: extracted 9 files, 8/8 checksums verified, change plan 4 findings, apply ok; one-byte tamper on APPLY.cmd aborts with "checksum mismatch"

notRestored: purged dead-PID logs (runtime产物, not backed up)
user environment variables (previous set/unset state recorded in user-env-before.json)

parityGaps: apply.command (macOS/Linux) does not strip deprecated references from package.json - it warns and names the line to remove
CL-007 on macOS/Linux reports status and prints export lines; it does not edit shell profiles
integration: v2.1.0 full pack will fold this engine into install.ps1 (install / upgrade / repair paths); until then this patch is the executable list.
